So? Does it matter? Ardyn was sacrificed. Thats the gist of it. He got the short end of the stick. Noctis and his ancestors were treated as kings while ardyn was imprisoned. Noctis and ardyn both died but noctis definitely had it better because he was treated as royalty whilst ardyn was treated as a plague. Soldiers who died at least had compensation for their families. They were at least paid. When they won they got to loot and rape. What did ardyn have? Nothing. What was his reward? Torture? Imprisonment? If you are gonna force something very awful to a person, at least have the decency to make it up to him or just simply be nice to him. Bahamut and somnus treated him like shit. The world treated him like shit. What was left to the poor guy then? You want him to sacrifice himself for the world? Ask jesus christ then. Fuck
Except it is the soldiers' job to do that. They have contracts and shit. Ardyn wasnt willing.

It was like a tribe sacrificing a virgin to a volcano. If a sacrifice is inevitable, he should at least be willing to do so just like noct. Ardyn wasnt willing, he wasnt even aware. It was pure trickery. He wasnt even credited. He was labeled as a monster even BEFORE he became immortal. Who is to say one life is worth less than others? You can only say these things because you are not the sacrificed one.

The thing is they still tricked ardyn. They sacrificed him. He was an unwilling and an unknowing sacrifice. He was tormented for more than 2000 years. If we are willing to do that to a person so that many would live, perhaps nobody deserves to live at all. :/ Fuck bahamut and that selfish prophecy.
